claims.statement: 河川流量（streamflow）は河川を流れる水の量を指し、「discharge（流量）」も同じ意味で使われる。

evidence.quote: We use the term "streamflow" to refer to the amount of water flowing in a river. Sometimes you'll also see the word "discharge" used to mean the same thing.

claims.statement: 流量は河川を単位時間あたりに流下する水の体積で、一般に立方フィート毎秒やガロン毎日で表され、横断面の水の面積に平均流速を掛けて求められる。

evidence.quote: Discharge is the volume of water moving down a stream or river per unit of time, commonly expressed in cubic feet per second or gallons per day.
river discharge is computed by multiplying the area of water in a channel cross section by the average velocity of the water in that cross section

claims.statement: 流出水の多くは小川や河川に集まり、下流へ向かって海へ流下する。

evidence.quote: A lot of runoff ends up in creeks, streams, and rivers, flowing downhill towards the oceans.

claims.statement: 流量を支配する最大の因子は流域内の降水由来の流出であり、流域のはるか上流だけに雨が降った場合でも河川は増水しうる。

evidence.quote: the main influence on streamflow is precipitation runoff in the watershed. Rainfall causes rivers to rise, and a river can even rise if it only rains very far up in the watershed

claims.statement: 地球上の淡水のうち河川の流水が占める割合は約0.006パーセントにすぎない。

evidence.quote: about 0.002 percent of all Earth's water is contained in rivers, and only 0.006 percent of the world's freshwater is in rivers

claims.statement: 河川水は飲料水供給・灌漑・発電・輸送などに利用され、河床を通じて下向きに水を排出して地下の帯水層を満たす川もある。

evidence.quote: people use river water to supply drinking-water, irrigate crops, produce electricity
Some streams even help keep the aquifers underground full of water by discharging water downward through their streambeds.

claims.statement: 水位（ステージまたはゲージハイト）は、ステージがゼロと定められた基準標高から測った水面の高さであり、ゼロ点は河床の近くに置かれることが多い。

evidence.quote: Stream stage (also called stage or gage height) is the height of the water surface, in feet, above an established altitude where the stage is zero. The zero level is arbitrary but is often close to the streambed.

claims.statement: 静水井は水中パイプで川とつながり、井内の水面が川の水面と同じ高さになる構造である。

evidence.quote: a stilling well dug into the river bank or attached to a bridge pier. Water from the river enters and leaves the stilling well through underwater pipes allowing the water surface in the stilling well to be at the same elevation as the water surface in the river.

claims.statement: 水位は静水井・バブルシステム・ワイヤー重錘量水標で測られ、バブルシステムは加圧ガスを水中の孔口から放出させるのに必要な圧力から水深を求める。

evidence.quote: The gage height (or stage) of a river most commonly is measured through the use of a stilling well, a bubble system, or a wire-weight gage.

pressurized gas (usually nitrogen or air) is forced through the pipe from inside the gage house and out a submerged opening called an orifice. The pressure in the pipe is determined by how deep the water is over the orifice.

claims.statement: 流量の実測では河道断面を多数の縦の小区間に分けて各区間流量を合算し、通常25〜30の等間隔の地点で測定が行われる。

evidence.quote: a river or stream will be measured at 25 to 30 regularly spaced locations across the river or stream
the stream channel cross section is divided into numerous vertical subsections

claims.statement: 音響ドップラー流速プロファイラー（ADCP）はドップラー効果の原理で流速を測り、河川表面を横断しながら断面の流速・水深・幅から流量を計算する。

evidence.quote: An ADCP uses the principles of the Doppler Effect to measure the velocity of water.
The ADCP is then guided across the surface of the river to obtain measurements of velocity and depth across the channel.

claims.statement: 水位流量関係は広い水位範囲の流量実測と対応する水位の組から定められ、USGSは多くの量水標で6〜8週間ごとに流量測定を行う。

evidence.quote: Stage-discharge relations are developed for streamgages by physically measuring the flow of the river with a mechanical current meter or ADCP at a wide range of stages
The USGS makes discharge measurements at most streamgages every 6 to 8 weeks

claims.statement: 水位流量関係は河道の形状・大きさ・勾配・粗度に依存し地点ごとに異なり、河床材料の侵食・堆積や季節的植生、漂着物、氷による河道変化のため継続的に検証される。

evidence.quote: The stage-discharge relation depends upon the shape, size, slope, and roughness of the channel at the streamgage and is different for every streamgage.
Changes in stream channels are often caused by erosion or deposition of streambed materials, seasonal vegetation growth, debris, or ice.

claims.statement: 多くのUSGS量水標は水位データを衛星経由で送信し、水位流量関係から推定された流量がほぼリアルタイムでオンライン公開される。

evidence.quote: Most USGS streamgages transmit stage data by satellite to USGS computers where the stage data are used to estimate streamflow using the developed stage-discharge relation
available online in near real time through Water Data for the Nation

claims.statement: USGSは1889年にニューメキシコ州のリオグランデ川に最初の量水標を設置し、灌漑用水が十分かを調べて新たな開発と西部開拓を支えることを目的とした。

evidence.quote: started its first streamgage in 1889 on the Rio Grande River in New Mexico to help determine if there was adequate water for irrigation purposes to encourage new development and western expansion

claims.statement: USGSは8,200を超える連続記録量水標を運用し、洪水予測、水の管理と配分、工学設計、研究、水門とダムの運用、レクリエーションの安全に流量情報を提供している。

evidence.quote: The USGS operates over 8,200 continuous-record streamgages that provide streamflow information for a wide variety of uses including flood prediction, water management and allocation, engineering design, research, operation of locks and dams, and recreational safety and enjoyment.

claims.statement: USGS量水標の水位測定は最も近い0.01フィートまたは水位の0.2パーセントのいずれか大きい方の精度で行われ、構造物の標高は永久水準標に対して定期的に測量される。

evidence.quote: Streamgages operated by the USGS provide stage measurements that are accurate to the nearest 0.01 foot or 0.2 percent of stage, whichever is greater.
the elevations of streamgage structures, and the associated stage measurement, are routinely surveyed relative to permanent elevation benchmarks near the streamgage

claims.statement: ピーチツリー・クリークでは2002年12月24日の降雨で基流時の約50立方フィート毎秒から数時間後に6,000立方フィート毎秒を超え、約150倍の水が流れた。

evidence.quote: the baseflow was about 50 ft3/s before the river started to rise, but that just a few hours later, at 9:00 AM streamflow was over 6, 000 ft3/s - that is about 150 times the amount of water flowing by as during baseflow conditions

claims.statement: 2003年5月6日の洪水ではピーチツリー・クリークの水位が17.77フィートに達し、対応する瞬間流量は6,960立方フィート毎秒だった。

evidence.quote: The flood peaked that day at 7:30 PM Eastern Time in the evening, when the stream stage reached 17.77 feet with a corresponding instantaneous streamflow of 6,960 cfs.

claims.statement: 小さな流域では嵐一つで基流時の約100倍の水が毎分流れ河川は数分から数時間で増減するが、大河は増減に数日かかることがある。

evidence.quote: In a small watershed, a storm can cause 100 times as much water to flow by each minute as during base-periods, but the river will rise and fall possibly in a matter of minutes and hours. Large rivers may take days to rise and fall

claims.statement: pHは水の酸性・塩基性の度合いを表す指標で、0から14の範囲を取り、7が中性、7未満が酸性、7超が塩基性である。

evidence.quote: pH is a measure of how acidic/basic water is. The range goes from 0 to 14, with 7 being neutral.
pHs of less than 7 indicate acidity, whereas a pH of greater than 7 indicates a base.

claims.statement: pHは対数目盛で1単位が10倍の差を表し、pH5の水はpH6の水の10倍酸性であり、水中の化学物質に左右されるため化学変化の指標となる。

evidence.quote: pH is reported in "logarithmic units". Each number represents a 10-fold change in the acidity/basicness of the water.
Water with a pH of five is ten times more acidic than water having a pH of six.
Since pH can be affected by chemicals in the water, pH is an important indicator of water that is changing chemically.

claims.statement: 溶存酸素（DO）は、水に溶けた酸素の量、すなわち水生生物が利用できる酸素量の尺度である。

evidence.quote: Dissolved oxygen (DO) is a measure of how much oxygen is dissolved in the water - the amount of oxygen available to living aquatic organisms.

claims.statement: 水に溶けている酸素は水100万分子あたり最大約10分子とごくわずかで、主に大気から河川に入り、魚類や浮遊動物が生存に必要とする。

evidence.quote: A small amount of oxygen, up to about ten molecules of oxygen per million of water, is actually dissolved in water.
Oxygen enters a stream mainly from the atmosphere
This dissolved oxygen is breathed by fish and zooplankton and is needed by them to survive.

claims.statement: 冷水は温水より多くの溶存酸素を保持できるため、水温の低い冬から初春に濃度が高くなる季節変動を持つ。

evidence.quote: Cold water can hold more dissolved oxygen than warm water.
In winter and early spring, when the water temperature is low, the dissolved oxygen concentration is high.

claims.statement: 濁度は液体の相対的な透明度の尺度で、水中の物質が散乱させる光の量を測る光学特性である。

evidence.quote: Turbidity is the measure of relative clarity of a liquid.
It is an optical characteristic of water and is a measurement of the amount of light that is scattered by material in the water when a light is shined through the water sample.

claims.statement: 濁りの原因は粘土・シルト・微細な有機無機物・藻類・プランクトンなどで、比濁計濃度単位（NTU）で報告され、基流時の多くの河川は10NTU未満である。

is measured by shining a light through the water and is reported in nephelometric turbidity units (NTU)
During periods of low flow (base flow), many rivers are a clear green color, and turbidities are low, usually less than 10 NTU.

of fish kills.

in water that have been shown to pose a risk to human health.

evidence.quote: Snowmelt is the result of solid snow melting into liquid water.

claims.statement: 雪解け由来の流出は、地球規模の水の移動における主要な構成要素である。

evidence.quote: runoff from snowmelt is a major component of the global movement of water

claims.statement: 標高や緯度が高く積雪が一年中残る場所では、堆積した雪の重みが雪を氷へと圧縮する。

claims.statement: 急峻な山地環境で形成された氷は、ゆっくりと斜面を下って流れて氷河となる。

claims.statement: 氷床とは、広がって5万平方キロメートルを超える領域を覆う氷河であり、氷床も氷河も水循環のプールの一部である。

evidence.quote: are glaciers that have spread outward to cover an area larger than 50,000 square kilometers.
Ice sheets and glaciers are all a part of the water cycle pool.

claims.statement: 米国西部やカナダなどの地域では、山地の雪原や氷河が天然の貯水池として機能する。

evidence.quote: Mountain snow fields and glaciers act as natural reservoirs for water in some areas, such as the western United States and Canada.

claims.statement: 米国西部の一部の州では、給水の最大75%が雪解けに由来する。

evidence.quote: As much as 75 percent of water supplies in some western states are derived from snowmelt.

claims.statement: 冬が春・夏へ移ると積雪が融け、河川へ水を放出する。

evidence.quote: When winter transitions to spring and summer, snowpacks melt, releasing water into rivers.

claims.statement: 年の特定の時期には、雪解けが河川流量の大半を占めることがある。

evidence.quote: During certain times of the year, snowmelt can be responsible for the majority of the streamflow in a river.

claims.statement: 寒冷気候では、春の流出と河川流量の多くが雪や氷の融解に由来する。

evidence.quote: much of the springtime runoff and streamflow in rivers is attributable to melting snow and ice

claims.statement: 雪解け由来の流出は、季節だけでなく年によっても変動する。

evidence.quote: runoff from snowmelt varies not only by season but also by year

claims.statement: 2001年の大干ばつではカリフォルニアの冬季降雪が減り、積雪として蓄えられた水の不足がその年の残りの期間の水の利用可能性に影響した。

evidence.quote: A major drought hit that area of California in 2001, reducing snowfall during the winter months.
The lack of water stored as snowpack affected the availability of water for the rest of the year.

claims.statement: 積雪の不足は下流の貯水池の水量にも影響し、灌漑用水や都市・町の給水に波及する。

evidence.quote: This also affects the amount of water in reservoirs located downstream
which in turn can affect water available for irrigation and the water supply for cities and towns

claims.statement: サウスプラット川では、灌漑水の浸透が春夏に沖積帯水層を涵養し、帯水層が秋冬にゆっくり河川へ排水することで年中流量が維持されている。

evidence.quote: seepage of irrigation water from ditches and fields replenishes the alluvial aquifers
the aquifer slowly drains into the river during fall and winter
This provides water that maintains streamflow in the South Platte River all year long.

claims.statement: 主に春に起こる雪解けによる洪水の可能性は世界中の多くの人々の懸念事項であり、急速な融雪は地滑りや土石流を誘発することもある。

evidence.quote: The effect of snowmelt on potential flooding, mainly during the spring, is something that causes concern for many people around the world.
Besides flooding, rapid snowmelt can trigger landslides and debris flows.

claims.statement: スイスのようなアルプス地域では融雪が流出の主要要素であり、融雪予報は融雪流出と洪水の可能性を予測する洪水警報ツールとして使われている。

evidence.quote: In alpine regions like Switzerland, snowmelt is a major component of runoff.
In Switzerland, snowmelt forecasting is being used as a flood-warning tool to predict snowmelt runoff and potential flooding.

claims.statement: 米国太平洋岸北西部などでは、既存の積雪に雨が降る「rain-on-snowイベント」で毎年春の洪水が発生し、斜面の土砂崩壊や河岸帯の被害と関連づけられてきた。

evidence.quote: annual springtime flood events occur when rain falls on existing snowpacks, known as a "rain-on-snow event."
Runoff during rain-on-snow events has been associated with mass-wasting of hill slopes

claims.statement: 1996年1月、大雪の後の急激な解凍と大雨が重なり、ニューヨークからペンシルベニア、バージニアに至る河川で洪水が発生した。

dwarf planet Ceres. Both small worlds reside in the debris-strewn main asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter

claims.statement: 小惑星の命名は国際天文学連合の小天体命名委員会が担うが厳格ではなく、愛猫を偲ぶ「Mr. Spock」やフランク・ザッパに由来する天体がある。

evidence.quote: not very strict when it comes to naming asteroids
we have one giant space rock named Mr. Spock
named for the late rock musician Frank Zappa

claims.statement: 小惑星には番号も付けられ、例えばアポフィスは (99942) Apophis と表記される。

evidence.quote: Asteroids are also given a number, for example (99942) Apophis

claims.statement: 地球近傍天体（NEO）は、地球の近傍まで達する軌道を持つ小惑星と彗星の総称で、近くの惑星の重力によって地球の近傍へ押し込まれた天体である。

evidence.quote: Asteroids and comets that have orbits that can bring them into Earth’s neighborhood are called Near-Earth Objects (NEOs).
Sometimes, asteroids and comets are nudged into Earth's neighborhood by the gravity of nearby planets.

claims.statement: NEOは地球の軌道から3,000万マイル（4,800万キロメートル）以内、およそ地球と太陽の距離の3分の1の範囲を公転している。

evidence.quote: They orbit within 30 million miles (48 million kilometers) of Earth’s orbit, or about one-third the distance between Earth and the Sun.

claims.statement: 軌道要素では、NEOは近日点距離qが1.3天文単位（地球と太陽の距離の1.3倍）未満の小惑星と彗星と定義される。

evidence.quote: NEOs are asteroids and comets with perihelion distance q less than 1.3 au
Their closest approach to the Sun is less than 1.3 times Earth's distance from the Sun.

claims.statement: NEOの大半は小惑星であり地球近傍小惑星（NEA）と呼ばれ、大きさは数フィートから数マイルまで分布し、これまでに数千個が発見されている。

evidence.quote: The vast majority of NEOs are asteroids. They range in size from a few feet across to several miles wide. Thousands of NEOs have been discovered.
The vast majority of NEOs are asteroids, referred to as Near-Earth Asteroids (NEAs).

claims.statement: 地球近傍彗星（NEC）は公転周期200年未満の短周期彗星だけに限定される。

evidence.quote: Near-Earth Comets (NECs) are further restricted to include only short-period comets (i.e., orbital period P less than 200 years).

claims.statement: NEAは近日点距離・遠日点距離・軌道長半径に応じてアティラ型・アテン型・アポロ型・アモル型の4群に分けられる。

evidence.quote: NEAs are divided into groups (Atira, Aten, Apollo and Amor) according to their perihelion distance (q), aphelion distance (Q) and their semi-major axes (a).

claims.statement: アティラ型は軌道全体が地球の軌道の内側に収まるNEAで、小惑星163693アティラにちなんで名付けられた。

evidence.quote: NEAs whose orbits are contained entirely with the orbit of the Earth (named after asteroid 163693 Atira).

claims.statement: アテン型は軌道長半径が地球より小さい地球横断型のNEAで、小惑星2062アテンにちなむ。

evidence.quote: Earth-crossing NEAs with semi-major axes smaller than Earth's (named after asteroid 2062 Aten).

claims.statement: アポロ型は軌道長半径が地球より大きい地球横断型のNEAで、小惑星1862アポロにちなむ。

evidence.quote: Earth-crossing NEAs with semi-major axes larger than Earth's (named after asteroid 1862 Apollo).

claims.statement: アモル型は地球の軌道の外側で火星の軌道の内側を回る地球接近型のNEAで、小惑星1221アモルにちなむ。

evidence.quote: Earth-approaching NEAs with orbits exterior to Earth's but interior to Mars' (named after asteroid 1221 Amor).

claims.statement: 実際に地球の軌道経路を横断する小惑星は地球横断型（Earth-crosser）と呼ばれる。

evidence.quote: Asteroids that actually cross Earth's orbital path are known as Earth-crossers.

claims.statement: 地球の軌道から460万マイル（750万キロメートル）以内に近づく軌道を持ち、推定直径が460フィート（140メートル）以上の小惑星は潜在的に危険な小惑星（PHA）と見なされるが、接近の可能性は衝突を意味しない。

evidence.quote: An asteroid is considered to be a potentially hazardous asteroid (PHA) when its orbit comes within 4.6 million miles (7.5 million kilometers) of Earth’s orbit, and it has an estimated diameter of 460 feet (140 meters) or greater.
This potential to make a close approach to Earth does not mean a PHA will impact the Earth.

claims.statement: PHAは地球最小軌道交差距離（MOID）が0.05天文単位以下かつ絶対等級Hが22.0以下の小惑星と定義される。

evidence.quote: all asteroids with an Earth Minimum Orbit Intersection Distance (MOID) of 0.05 au or less and an absolute magnitude (H) of 22.0 or less are considered PHAs

claims.statement: 言い換えれば、地球へ0.05天文単位（約748万キロメートル）より近づけないものや直径約140メートルより小さいものはPHAとは見なされない。

evidence.quote: asteroids that can't get any closer to the Earth (i.e., MOID) than 0.05 au (roughly 7,480,000 km or 4,650,000 mi) or are smaller than about 140 m (~500 ft) in diameter

claims.statement: 直径約10メートルの小惑星は10年に1度ほど地球へ落下して明るい火球と強いソニックブームを起こし、約50メートルのものは約1,000年に1度、約140メートルのものは約2万年に1度衝突して直径1〜2キロメートルのクレーターを作る。

evidence.quote: Asteroids of this size impact Earth about once a decade, causing a very bright fireball, and a strong sonic boom.
It’s predicted that asteroids of this size impact Earth about every 1,000 years, and cause local devastation.
An asteroid of this size hits Earth about every 20,000 years, creating a crater 3,000 feet to 7,000 feet (1 to 2 kilometers) in diameter.

claims.statement: CNEOSの科学者によれば、広範囲の被害をもたらすほど大きな小惑星が今後100年以上の間に地球へ衝突する可能性は極めて低い。

evidence.quote: It is highly unlikely that an asteroid large enough to cause widespread damage will impact Earth for the next 100 years or more

claims.statement: CNEOSは小惑星と彗星の追跡、軌道の計算、地球への危険性の判定を専門とする。

evidence.quote: CNEOS specializes in tracking asteroids and comets, calculating their orbits, and determining whether any of them are hazardous to Earth.

claims.statement: 科学者は地球の軌道と交差する地球横断小惑星と、地球の軌道距離まで約2,800万マイル（4,500万キロメートル）以内に近づく地球近傍小惑星を継続的に監視し、レーダーが検出と監視の有力な手段となっている。

evidence.quote: Scientists continuously monitor Earth-crossing asteroids, whose paths intersect Earth's orbit, and near-Earth asteroids that approach Earth's orbital distance to within about 28 million miles (45 million kilometers) and may pose an impact danger.
Radar is a valuable tool in detecting and monitoring potential impact hazards.

claims.statement: NASAは2016年に惑星防衛調整室（PDCO）を設置し、地球への衝突危険があり得る小惑星と彗星を発見・追跡・理解する活動を統括している。

evidence.quote: In 2016, NASA established the Planetary Defense Coordination Office (PDCO) to manage the agency's ongoing mission of finding, tracking, and better understanding asteroids and comets that could pose an impact hazard to Earth.

claims.statement: 地上の観測所と宇宙望遠鏡のネットワークがこれらのNEOを監視している。

evidence.quote: A network of ground-based observatories and space-based telescopes monitor these Near-Earth Objects (NEOs)

claims.statement: 危険なNEOが今後50年以内に1%以上の確率で地球へ衝突すると判明した場合、PDCOは大統領府・連邦議会などへの通知を担い、公式オンラインチャンネルを通じて報道と一般へ接近情報を提供する。

evidence.quote: If any hazardous NEO is found to have a 1% or greater chance of impacting Earth over the next 50 years, the Planetary Defense Coordination Office is responsible for providing notification messages for NASA to send to the Executive Office of the President, the U.S. Congress, and other government departments and agencies.
PDCO also provides timely and accurate information regarding close approaches of NEOs to the news media and the public via NASA’s official online communications channels

claims.statement: NEO SurveyorはNEO探査を加速する赤外線宇宙望遠鏡で、地球から3,000万マイル以内に来る潜在的に危険な小惑星・彗星の大半の発見と特性把握を目指している。

evidence.quote: An infrared space telescope designed to accelerate NASA's search for NEOs.
Designed to help NASA discover and characterize most of the potentially hazardous asteroids and comets that come within 30 million miles of Earth.

claims.statement: DARTは世界初の小惑星偏向技術の実証で、2022年9月26日に小惑星の衛星ディモルフォスへ意図的に衝突し、その軌道と形状を変えることに成功した。

evidence.quote: The world's first demonstration of asteroid deflection technology.
DART intentionally impacted asteroid moonlet Dimorphos on Sept. 26, 2022, and successfully altered its orbit and physical shape.

claims.statement: NASAの可視化ツールでは、NEOに分類された既知のすべての小惑星と彗星をリアルタイムに見ることができる。

evidence.quote: real-time visualization of every known asteroid or comet classified as a Near-Earth Object, or NEO

claims.statement: 彗星も過去に地球へ衝突したが、小惑星よりはるかに数が少ないため衝突はまれで、典型的なサイズの彗星は1,000万〜5,000万年に1度しか地球へ衝突しないとされる。

evidence.quote: Comets also have hit Earth in the past, but there are far, far fewer comets than asteroids, so comet impacts are very rare.
A typical-size comet hits Earth only once every 10 to 50 million years, according to Dr. Paul Chodas, director of CNEOS.

claims.statement: カイパーベルトは海王星の軌道の外側にあるドーナツ状の氷天体の領域で、冥王星と既知の準惑星の多く、一部の彗星の故郷である。

evidence.quote: The Kuiper Belt is a doughnut-shaped region of icy objects beyond the orbit of Neptune. It is home to Pluto and most of the known dwarf planets and some comets.

claims.statement: 太陽系の「第三の領域」とも呼ばれ、小さな氷天体が数百万個あり、そのうち数十万個は幅60マイル（100キロメートル）を超え、冥王星を含め600マイル（1,000キロメートル）超のものもあると考えられる。

evidence.quote: It's sometimes called the "third zone" of the solar system.
Astronomers think there are millions of small, icy objects in this region – including hundreds of thousands that are larger than 60 miles (100 kilometers) wide.
Some of the objects, including Pluto, are over 600 miles (1,000 kilometers) wide.

claims.statement: カイパーベルトの天体は岩石と水氷のほか、アンモニアやメタンなど多様な凍結物質を含む。

evidence.quote: In addition to rock and water ice, objects in the Kuiper Belt also contain a variety of other frozen compounds like ammonia and methane.

claims.statement: 名称は1951年に冥王星の外側の天体を予想した論文を発表したジェラード・カイパーに由来し、エッジワース・カイパーベルトや海王星外領域（TNO）と呼ばれることもある。

evidence.quote: The region is named for astronomer Gerard Kuiper, who published a scientific paper in 1951 that speculated about objects beyond Pluto.
Some researchers prefer to call it the Trans-Neptunian Region, and refer to Kuiper Belt objects (KBOs) as trans-Neptunian objects, or TNOs.

claims.statement: 内側の縁は海王星の軌道のあたり太陽から約30AUに始まり、主領域は約50AUまでで、散乱円盤は約1,000AUまで続く。

evidence.quote: Its inner edge begins at the orbit of Neptune, at about 30 AU from the Sun.
The inner, main region of the Kuiper Belt ends around 50 AU from the Sun.
a second region called the scattered disk, which continues outward to nearly 1,000 AU

claims.statement: 2,000を超える海王星外天体が記録されたが推定総数のごく一部で、カイパーベルト全体の質量は地球の約10%以下と見積もられる。

evidence.quote: So far, more than 2,000 trans-Neptunian objects have been cataloged by observers
the total mass of all the material in the Kuiper Belt is estimated to be no more than about 10% of the mass of Earth.

claims.statement: カイパーベルトの氷天体は太陽系形成の残骸で、海王星の重力に掻き乱されたため大きな惑星へ合体できなかった。

evidence.quote: Astronomers think the icy objects of the Kuiper Belt are remnants left over from the formation of the solar system.
Instead, Neptune's gravity stirred up this region of space so much that the small, icy objects there weren't able to coalesce into a large planet.

claims.statement: 元の物質は地球の7〜10倍の質量と見込まれたが、巨大惑星の軌道移動で大半が失われ、木星が小天体を極端に遠い軌道（オールトの雲）か太陽系外へ弾き飛ばした。

evidence.quote: the shifting orbits of the four giant planets (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune) could have caused most of the original material – likely 7 to 10 times the mass of Earth – to be lost.
Jupiter ultimately slingshotted most of these icy bodies either into extremely distant orbits (to form the Oort Cloud) or out of the solar system entirely.

claims.statement: カイパーベルトは現在もゆっくり浸食されており、天体同士の衝突が小天体や彗星、太陽風で吹き飛ばされる塵を生んでいる。

evidence.quote: Today the Kuiper Belt is slowly eroding away. Objects that remain there occasionally collide, producing smaller objects fragmented by the collision, sometimes comets and also dust that's blown out of the solar system by the solar wind.

claims.statement: KBOは大きさ・形・色が多様で一様に分布せず、軌道の形で複数の集団に分けられ、どの集団に属するかは海王星との相互作用の歴史を反映する。

evidence.quote: they're fairly diverse in size, shape, and color. And importantly, they're not evenly distributed through space
there are several distinct groupings, or populations, of these objects whose orbits provide clues about their history.

claims.statement: 古典的KBOは平均距離約40〜50AUで、ほぼ円形で傾きの小さい「コールド」と、より楕円で傾いた「ホット」に分かれる。

evidence.quote: All classical KBOs have a similar average distance from the Sun between about 40 and 50 AU.
Cold classical KBOs have relatively circular orbits that are not tilted much away from the plane of the planets; hot classical KBOs have more elliptical and tilted orbits

claims.statement: コールド型は海王星に近づかず軌道が数十億年ほぼ不変で、ホット型は過去の海王星との相互作用で軌道が伸ばされ傾けられた。

evidence.quote: The cold classical KBOs have orbits that never come very close to Neptune, and thus they remain "cool" and unperturbed by the giant planet's gravity. Their orbits likely haven't moved much for billions of years.
These interactions pumped energy into their orbits, which stretched them into an elliptical shape, and tilted them slightly out of the plane of the planets.

claims.statement: 共鳴KBOは海王星と共鳴する安定した繰り返しパターンの軌道にあり、冥王星は3:2共鳴で、この共鳴を持つ天体群はプルーティノと呼ばれる。

evidence.quote: They orbit in resonance with the giant planet, meaning their orbits are in a stable, repeating pattern with Neptune's.
For example, Pluto is in a 3:2 resonance with Neptune, meaning it circles the Sun twice for every three times Neptune goes around.
astronomers have given them their own category among the resonant KBOs: the plutinos.

claims.statement: 散乱円盤には海王星に散乱された大きく楕円で傾いた軌道の天体がおり、傾斜が数十度のものや遠日点が数百AUのものもあり、エリスが最大の既知の構成員である。

evidence.quote: It is home to objects that have been scattered by Neptune into orbits that are highly elliptical and highly inclined to the plane of the planets.
Many scattered disk objects have orbits that are tilted by tens of degrees. Some venture hundreds of AU from the Sun
Eris is an example of an object in the scattered disk and is the largest known member of this population.

claims.statement: 分離天体は太陽へ約40AUより近づかず、セドナは近日点76AU、遠日点約1,200AUに達する。

evidence.quote: Detached Kuiper Belt objects have orbits that never come closer to the Sun than about 40 AU.
Sedna is an example of a detached KBO. The closest it comes to the Sun is 76 AU, while at its farthest it travels out to ~1200 AU.

claims.statement: ケンタウルスは木星と海王星の間を渡る天体で、大半が太陽系外へ放出されるか内側へ押し込まれて彗星になる運命にあり、カイパーベルトからの比較的新しい脱出者と考えられる。

evidence.quote: Centaurs are objects with orbits that travel through the space between the orbits of Jupiter and Neptune.
most are fated to either be ejected from the solar system or pushed into the inner solar system where they become comets or crash into the Sun and planets.
they're relatively recent escapees from the Kuiper Belt.

claims.statement: 冥王星は1930年に最初に発見されたKBOで領域最大の天体だがエリスの方がわずかに質量が大きく、3:2共鳴のため海王星の影響をほとんど受けず、実際には天王星の方へ近づく。

evidence.quote: In 1930, Pluto became the first Kuiper Belt object to be discovered.
it's the largest object in the region, even though another object similar in size, called Eris, has a slightly higher mass.
Pluto gets physically closer to Uranus than it ever does to Neptune.

claims.statement: 衛星を持つKBOや二重天体が多く、接触した「接触二重天体」はピーナツ状になり、冥王星・エリス・ハウメア・マケマケは衛星を持ち、二重天体の多くは原初的な天体と考えられる。

evidence.quote: A fairly large number of KBOs either have moons – that is, significantly smaller bodies that orbit them – or are binary objects.
Some binaries actually touch, creating a sort of peanut shape, creating what's known as a contact binary.
Dwarf planets Pluto, Eris, Haumea, and Makemake are all Kuiper Belt objects that have moons.

claims.statement: アロコスは接触二重天体で、2014年にニュー・ホライズンズのチームがハッブル宇宙望遠鏡で発見し、探査機が2019年1月1日に最接近した史上最も遠く最も原始的な探査天体である。

evidence.quote: The small Kuiper Belt Object called Arrokoth is a contact binary. It was discovered in 2014 by NASA’s New Horizons science team, using the Hubble Space Telescope.
Arrokoth is the most distant and the most primitive object ever explored by a spacecraft.

claims.statement: 衝突破片が海王星に太陽方向へ押し込まれ、木星が周期20年以下の軌道へまとめたものが短周期木星族彗星で、多くは揮発性の氷を使い果たして休眠状態になる。

evidence.quote: Pieces produced by colliding KBOs can be pushed by Neptune's gravity into orbits that send them sunward, where Jupiter further corrals them into short loops lasting 20 years or less. These are called short-period Jupiter-family comets.
most tend to exhaust their volatile ices fairly quickly and eventually become dormant, or dead, comets with little or no detectable activity.

claims.statement: 一部の地球近傍小惑星は燃え尽きた彗星で多くがカイパーベルト起源と考えられ、もう一つの彗星の供給源は高い傾斜軌道の長周期彗星のもととなるオールトの雲である。

evidence.quote: Researchers have found that some near-Earth asteroids are actually burned-out comets, and most of them would have started out in the Kuiper Belt.
The other source of comets is the Oort Cloud, where most long-period comets on highly tilted orbits come from.

claims.statement: 知識の大半は地上望遠鏡とハッブル宇宙望遠鏡から得られ、訪れた探査機はニュー・ホライズンズのみで、2015年7月に冥王星へ、2019年1月1日にアロコスへ最接近した。

evidence.quote: Most of what we know about the Kuiper Belt comes from ground-based telescopes and the Hubble Space Telescope.
Only one spacecraft has visited the Kuiper Belt. NASA’s New Horizons flew past Pluto in July 2015
On Jan. 1, 2019, the spacecraft flew by a Kuiper Belt object later named Arrokoth.

claims.statement: ニュー・ホライズンズは2015年7月14日に冥王星とその衛星を初めて間近で探査し、太陽から約30〜50AUのこの領域を調べるNASAのミッションである。

evidence.quote: NASA's New Horizons spacecraft was the first spacecraft to explore Pluto up close, flying by the dwarf planet and its moons on July 14, 2015.
a region of the solar system that extends from about 30 AU, near the orbit of Neptune, to about 50 AU from the Sun.

claims.statement: 1950年にヤン・オールトが、一部の彗星は太陽系を取り囲むはるか遠方の球殻状の氷天体の領域から来ると提唱し、オールトの雲と名付けられたその群は5,000〜100,000天文単位の空間を占めるとされる。

evidence.quote: In 1950, astronomer Jan Oort proposed that some comets come from a vast, extremely distant spherical shell of icy bodies surrounding the solar system.
This giant swarm of objects, now named the Oort Cloud, occupies space at a distance between 5,000 and 100,000 astronomical units.

claims.statement: オールトの雲は太陽と惑星、カイパーベルト天体を取り囲む球殻状の巨大な集まりで、氷の彗星状天体からなる分厚い泡のような構造と考えられる。

evidence.quote: Scientists think the Oort Cloud is a giant spherical shell surrounding the Sun, planets and Kuiper Belt Objects. It's like a big, thick bubble around our solar system, made of icy, comet-like objects.

claims.statement: オールトはこの雲を、長周期彗星の由来と、なぜ惑星・小惑星・カイパーベルトが共有する軌道面に沿わずあらゆる方向から現れるのかを説明するために提案した。

evidence.quote: Dutch astronomer Jan Oort proposed the existence of the cloud to explain (among other things) where long-period comets come from, and why they seem to come from all directions rather than along the orbital plane shared by the planets, asteroids and the Kuiper Belt.

claims.statement: オールトの雲は太陽系で最も遠い領域で、次の恒星までの距離の4分の1から半分ほどまで広がるとも言われる。

evidence.quote: The Oort Cloud is the most distant region in our solar system
extending perhaps one-quarter to halfway from our Sun to the next star.

claims.statement: 天文単位（AU）は地球と太陽の距離で、約9,300万マイル（約1億5,000万キロメートル）と定義される。

evidence.quote: a unit defined as the distance between Earth and the Sun, with 1 AU being roughly 93 million miles or 150 million kilometers.

claims.statement: オールトの雲の内縁は太陽から2,000〜5,000AU、外縁は10,000〜100,000AUと考えられ、比較として冥王星の軌道は約30〜50AUである。

evidence.quote: The inner edge of the Oort Cloud, however, is thought to be located between 2,000 and 5,000 AU from the Sun, with the outer edge being located somewhere between 10,000 and 100,000 AU from the Sun.
Pluto’s more elliptical orbit carries it between about 30 and 50 astronomical units from the Sun.

claims.statement: 1日約100万マイルの速度のボイジャー1号でもオールトの雲に入るまで約300年、外縁を抜けるまでおそらく約3万年かかる。

evidence.quote: At its current speed of about a million miles a day, NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft won't enter the Oort Cloud for about 300 years. And it won’t exit the outer edge for maybe 30,000 years.

claims.statement: 太陽の光は地球へ8分強、海王星の軌道へ約4.5時間、ヘリオポーズへさらに約12時間で届くが、オールトの雲の内縁へはさらに10〜28日、外縁を通過するまで最大1年半ほどかかるとされる。

evidence.quote: When light leaves the Sun, it takes a little over eight minutes to reach Earth, and about 4.5 hours to reach Neptune’s orbit.
Just under three hours after passing Neptune’s orbit, the Sun’s light passes beyond the outer edge of the Kuiper Belt.
After another 12 hours the sunlight reaches the heliopause

it will be another 10 to 28 days before that same sunlight reaches the inner edge of the Oort Cloud, and perhaps as much as a year and a half before the sunlight passes beyond the Oort Cloud’s outer edge.

claims.statement: オールトの雲は冥王星やカイパーベルトの最も遠い縁のはるか彼方にあるため、NASAはその直接画像を持っていない。

evidence.quote: The Oort Cloud lies far beyond Pluto and the most distant edges of the Kuiper Belt.
Because it is so far away, NASA doesn't have direct images of the Oort Cloud.

claims.statement: 有力な説では、46億年前の惑星形成後に残った残骸である微惑星を、惑星（主に木星）の重力があらゆる方向へ散乱させた。

evidence.quote: After the planets formed 4.6 billion years ago, the region in which they formed still contained lots of leftover chunks called planetesimals. Planetesimals formed from the same material as the planets did.
The gravity of the planets (primarily Jupiter) then scattered the planetesimals every which way.

claims.statement: 一部は太陽系外へ放出され、他は太陽の重力に捉えられたまま銀河の潮汐力などが及ぶ遠方の偏心軌道へ放り込まれ、境界領域に落ち着いてオールトの雲になったとされ、太陽系外の天体を捕獲した可能性もある。

evidence.quote: Some planetesimals were ejected from the solar system entirely, while others were flung into eccentric orbits where they were still held by the Sun’s gravity, but were far enough out that galactic influences also tugged on them. Likely the strongest influence was the tidal force from our galaxy itself.

gravity from the planets shoved many icy planetesimals away from the Sun, and gravity from the galaxy likely caused them to settle in the borderlands of the solar system, where the planets couldn’t perturb them anymore.
the Oort Cloud could also capture objects that didn’t form in the solar system.

claims.statement: オールトの雲の天体は共有の軌道面を同じ方向に回らず、上下さまざまな傾きで分厚い泡のように太陽を回るため「ベルト」ではなく「雲」と呼ばれる。

evidence.quote: objects in Oort Cloud do not necessarily travel in the same direction in a shared orbital plane around the Sun. Instead, they can travel under, over and at various inclinations, around the Sun as a thick bubble of distant, icy debris. Hence, they’re called the Oort Cloud rather than the Oort Belt.

claims.statement: オールトの雲には数千億、場合によっては数兆個の氷天体があるとされる。

evidence.quote: There may be hundreds of billions, even trillions, of icy bodies in the Oort Cloud.

claims.statement: 天体の軌道が乱されると太陽への長い落下を始め、彗星ISONは太陽に近づきすぎて崩壊し、火星へ大接近したサイディング・スプリングは約74万年後まで戻らない。

evidence.quote: Now and then, something disturbs the orbit of one of these icy worlds, and it begins a long fall toward our Sun.
ISON disintegrated when it passed too close to the Sun. Siding Spring, which made a very close pass by Mars, survived its visit to the inner solar system, but will not return for about 740,000 years.

claims.statement: 既知の長周期彗星の大半は軌道周期が長いため記録史上1度しか見られず、形成以来数十億年で一度も太陽へ近づいたことのない天体もある。

evidence.quote: Most known long-period comets have been seen only once in recorded history because their orbital periods are so, well, long.
Others have never ventured close to the Sun in the billions of years since they formed.

claims.statement: 長周期彗星の多くは太陽から約100,000天文単位のオールトの雲から到来し、1周に最大3,000万年かかるものもある。

evidence.quote: Less predictable are long-period comets, many of which arrive from a region called the Oort Cloud about 100,000 astronomical units (that is, about 100,000 times the distance between Earth and the Sun) from the Sun. These Oort Cloud comets can take as long as 30 million years to complete one trip around the Sun.

claims.statement: 短周期彗星は200年未満で公転するため、以前にも姿を見せたものが多く再現を予測しやすい。

evidence.quote: Taking less than 200 years to orbit the Sun, in many cases their appearance is predictable because they have passed by before.

claims.statement: NASAのNEOWISEは2010年4月20日にオールトの雲の彗星C/2006 W3（クリステンセン）を、地球から約3億7,000万マイル（6億キロメートル）の距離で観測した。

evidence.quote: NEOWISE observed the comet on April 20th, 2010, when it was nearly 370 million miles (600 million kilometers) from Earth.

claims.statement: オールトの雲の天体は、彗星の軌道から推測された理論上の氷天体の集まりである。

evidence.quote: a theorized group of icy objects collectively called the Oort Cloud

claims.statement: 長周期彗星の中には、前回内太陽系を通過した時点で人類がまだ存在しなかったほど長い軌道を持つものもある。

evidence.quote: Some have orbits so long that the last time they passed through the inner solar system, our species did not yet exist.

claims.statement: 短周期彗星は海王星の外側の円盤状の氷天体の領域から来るとされ、重力に押し込まれて太陽へ近づく軌道になった天体である。

evidence.quote: a disc-like belt of icy bodies exists beyond Neptune, where a population of dark comets orbits the Sun in the realm of Pluto.
These icy objects, occasionally pushed by gravity into orbits bringing them closer to the Sun, become the so-called short-period comets.

claims.statement: 宇宙空間にある小さな岩石は流星体（meteoroid）と呼ばれ、大きさは塵の粒から小さな小惑星ほどまでさまざまである。

evidence.quote: Meteoroids are space rocks that range in size from dust grains to small asteroids.
These rocks still are in space.

claims.statement: 流星体が地球や他惑星の大気へ高速で突入して燃え尽きると「流れ星」と呼ばれる流星になり、金星より明るいものは火球と呼ばれる。

evidence.quote: When meteoroids enter Earth’s atmosphere (or that of another planet, like Mars) at high speed and burn up, the fireballs or “shooting stars” are called meteors.
Sometimes meteors can even appear brighter than Venus – that’s when we call them “fireballs.”

claims.statement: 1日あたり約48.5トン（44,000キログラム）の隕石質物質が地球へ落下し、そのほぼすべてが大気中で蒸発して「流れ星」の明るい筋を残す。

evidence.quote: Scientists estimate that about 48.5 tons (44 tonnes or 44,000 kilograms) of meteoritic material falls on Earth each day.
Almost all the material is vaporized in Earth's atmosphere, leaving a bright trail fondly called "shooting stars."

claims.statement: 晴れた夜には通常1時間に数個の流星が見られるが、その数が劇的に増える現象が流星群である。

evidence.quote: Several meteors per hour can usually be seen on any given night. Sometimes the number increases dramatically—these events are called meteor showers.
Several meteors per hour can usually be seen on any clear night. When there are lots more meteors, you’re watching a meteor shower.

claims.statement: 流星群は毎年または定期的に、彗星が残した塵の残骸の通り道を地球が通過するときに起こり、まれに小惑星由来のものもある。

evidence.quote: Meteor showers occur annually or at regular intervals as the Earth passes through the trail of dusty debris left by a comet.
Some meteor showers occur annually or at regular intervals as the Earth passes through the trail of dusty debris left by a comet (and, in a few cases, asteroids).

claims.statement: 彗星は太陽に近づくと加熱され、巨大な輝く頭部へ塵とガスを噴き出し、太陽から数百万マイルに及ぶ尾を作る。

evidence.quote: When a comet's orbit brings it close to the Sun, it heats up and spews dust and gases into a giant glowing head larger than most planets. The dust and gases form a tail that stretches away from the Sun for millions of miles.

claims.statement: 彗星はカイパーベルトやさらに遠いオールトの雲に数十億個も存在すると考えられている。

evidence.quote: There are likely billions of comets orbiting our Sun in the Kuiper Belt and even more distant Oort Cloud.

claims.statement: 流星群は、流星が現れるように見える空の位置に近い恒星や星座にちなんで名付けられるのが通例である。

evidence.quote: Meteor showers are usually named after a star or constellation that is close to where the meteors appear in the sky.
Meteor showers are usually named after a star or constellation that is close to where the meteors appear to originate in the sky.

claims.statement: 最も有名なペルセウス座流星群は毎年8月12日頃に極大を迎え、その1粒1粒は135年周期のスイフト・タットル彗星の破片である。

evidence.quote: Perhaps the most famous are the Perseids, which peak around August 12 every year. Every Perseid meteor is a tiny piece of the comet Swift-Tuttle, which swings by the Sun every 135 years.

claims.statement: しし座流星群はテンペル・タットル彗星、みずがめ座とオリオン座流星群はハレー彗星、おうし座流星群はエンケ彗星に由来する。

evidence.quote: Other notable meteor showers include the Leonids, associated with comet Tempel-Tuttle; the Aquarids and Orionids, linked to comet Halley, and the Taurids, associated with comet Encke.

claims.statement: ふたご座流星群は12月12〜13日頃に極大で条件が良ければ1時間に150個とされ、母天体は小惑星(3200)ファエトンである。

evidence.quote: Geminids
(3200) Phaethon

claims.statement: りゅう座流星群は1月3〜4日に極大で1時間120個、母天体は(196256) 2003 EH1とされる。

evidence.quote: Quadrantids

claims.statement: 彗星の残骸は砂粒から豆粒ほどの大きさで大半は地上へ届く前に燃え尽き、流星の塵は高空を飛ぶ航空機で採取されNASAの研究所で分析されることもある。

evidence.quote: Most of this comet debris is between the size of a grain of sand and a pea and burns up in the atmosphere before reaching the ground.
Sometimes, meteor dust is captured by high-altitude aircraft and analyzed in NASA laboratories.

claims.statement: 大気を通り抜けて地上へ届いた流星体は隕石と呼ばれ、典型的には小石から握りこぶしほどの大きさである。

evidence.quote: When a meteoroid survives its trip through the atmosphere and hits the ground, it’s called a meteorite. Meteorites typically range between the size of a pebble and a fist.

claims.statement: サッカー場より小さい宇宙岩の大半は大気中で分解し、地上へ届くのは元の天体の5%未満が普通である。

evidence.quote: Most space rocks smaller than a football field will break apart in Earth’s atmosphere.
Less than 5% of the original object usually makes it down to the ground.

claims.statement: 彗星由来の物質はもろく小さな破片は大気突入を生き残れないため、流星群の後に隕石が見つかることは期待できず、タウリッドやジェミニド由来と確実に追跡されたものもない。

evidence.quote: Don’t expect to find meteorites after a meteor shower. Most meteor showers come from comets, whose material is quite fragile. Small comet fragments generally won’t survive entry into our atmosphere.
In theory, the Taurids and Geminids could send meteorites down to our surface every once in a while, but no remnants have been traced to them definitively.

claims.statement: 流星体は、彗星や小惑星、月や他の惑星といったより大きな天体から砕けて飛び出した破片で、岩石質のものも金属質のものもある。

evidence.quote: Most meteoroids are pieces of other, larger bodies that have been broken or blasted off. Some come from comets, others from asteroids, and some even come from the Moon and other planets.
Some meteoroids are rocky, while others are metallic, or combinations of rock and metal.

claims.statement: NASAは金星より明るい流星（火球）を観測するカメラ網、全米火球ネットワークを運用している。

evidence.quote: A network of cameras set up by NASA to observe meteors brighter than the planet Venus, which are called fireballs.

claims.statement: 2013年にチェリャビンスク上空へ家ほどの流星体が秒速18キロメートル超で突入し高度23キロメートルで爆発し、約44万トンのTNTに相当するエネルギーで200平方マイル超の窓を破壊し1,600人超が負傷した。

evidence.quote: The house-sized meteoroid entered the atmosphere at over 11 miles (18 kilometers) per second and blew apart 14 miles (23 kilometers) above the ground.
The explosion released the energy equivalent of around 440,000 tons of TNT and generated a shock wave that blew out windows over 200 square miles (518 square kilometers) and damaged buildings.
More than 1,600 people were injured in the blast, mostly due to broken glass.

claims.statement: これまでに5万個を超える隕石が地球で発見され、その99.8%は小惑星由来で、残る0.2%は火星と月由来がほぼ半々である。

evidence.quote: More than 50,000 meteorites have been found on Earth.
Of these, 99.8% come from asteroids. The remaining small fraction (0.2%) of meteorites is split roughly equally between meteorites from Mars and the Moon.

claims.statement: 隕石は「鉄隕石」「石隕石」「石鉄隕石」の3種に大別され、落下する隕石の大半は石隕石だが、落下後長い時間を経て発見されるものの多くは地球の岩石より重く区別しやすい鉄隕石である。

evidence.quote: There are three major types of meteorites: the "irons," the "stonys," and the "stony-irons."
Although the majority of meteorites that fall to Earth are stony, most of the meteorites discovered long after they fall are irons.

claims.statement: 砂が広がる砂漠や南極の氷の大地では、暗い隕石が見つけやすい。

evidence.quote: In sandy deserts with large, open regions of sand and few rocks, dark meteorites stand out. Similarly, meteorites can be much easier to spot in cold, icy deserts, such as the frozen plains of Antarctica.

claims.statement: 1908年のツングースカ事件では、直径約37メートルの流星体が地上数キロ上空で爆発し、数百マイル四方の森林をなぎ倒した。

evidence.quote: The only entry of a large meteoroid into Earth’s atmosphere in modern history with firsthand accounts was the Tunguska event of 1908.
it exploded in the air a few miles up. The force of the explosion was powerful enough to knock over trees in a region hundreds of miles wide.
Scientists think the meteor itself was about 120 feet (37 meters) across

claims.statement: 同じ天体でも、宇宙空間・大気中・地上という所在によって流星体・流星・隕石と呼び分けられる。

evidence.quote: we call the same objects by different names, depending on where they are located.

claims.statement: 国連が注目する「極度の貧困」とは、世界の最も貧しい人々に注意を向けるために設けられた、きわめて低い貧困ラインを下回る状態を指す。

evidence.quote: The United Nations focuses on “extreme poverty”, an extremely low poverty line that has the purpose of drawing attention to the very poorest people in the world.

claims.statement: 国連は、国際貧困ライン（IPL）と呼ばれる閾値を下回って暮らす人々の割合の推定を世界銀行に委ねている。

evidence.quote: the United Nations relies on the World Bank to estimate the share of people living below a certain threshold, called the International Poverty Line (IPL).

claims.statement: 2025年6月、世界銀行は国際貧困ラインを1日2.15ドルから3ドルへ大幅に引き上げた。

evidence.quote: In June 2025, the World Bank announced a major change to this line, raising it significantly, from $2.15 to $3 per day.

claims.statement: 今回の引き上げで、以前は極度の貧困として数えられなかった約1億2500万人が新たに対象へ加えられた。

evidence.quote: 125 million people who would not have been counted as extremely poor before June are now included.

claims.statement: 1日3ドルの新しいラインで見た2024年の極度の貧困人口は8億1700万人と推定された。

evidence.quote: 817 million people lived in extreme poverty in 2024 under the new $3 a day line

claims.statement: 極度の貧困の推定値が増えたのは、世界が貧しくなったためではなく、貧困の閾値が高くなったためである。

evidence.quote: The higher estimates of extreme poverty reflect a higher poverty threshold, not that the world is poorer.

claims.statement: 更新後のデータでは、所得分布の下位10%の人々は旧データより16%多く購入・消費できるとされる。

evidence.quote: those at the bottom 10% of the global distribution can buy and consume more — 16% more — than the old data showed

claims.statement: 世界の極度の貧困の推定は、世界の所得分布の推定と国際貧困ラインという閾値の設定という2つの部分からなる。

evidence.quote: Estimating global extreme poverty involves two parts
the World Bank estimates the global distribution of income
it defines an extreme poverty threshold, the International Poverty Line

claims.statement: 統計担当者が人々の所得を知る主な方法は家計調査による聞き取りであり、ほぼすべての国が家計調査を実施している。

evidence.quote: The main way statisticians find out about people’s incomes is by asking them. Almost all countries run household surveys to gather this information.

claims.statement: 国際貧困ラインは低所得国の各国貧困ラインの中央値にアンカーされ、最新の設定ではデータのある23か国の中央値3.04ドルを丸めて3ドルとされた。

evidence.quote: the World Bank anchors the IPL to the national poverty lines adopted by low-income countries
the median poverty line among the 23 countries with available data to be $3.04, which was rounded to give $3

claims.statement: 世界の最富裕国の貧困ラインは1日30ドルから40ドルである。

evidence.quote: Among the world’s richest countries, poverty lines are much higher, at $30 or $40 per day.

claims.statement: 各国通貨のデータは国際ドルという仮想通貨へ換算され、国間の生活費の差が調整される。PPPは数年ごとの「ラウンド」で収集される詳細な物価データに基づく。

evidence.quote: converting the local currency data into international dollars. This hypothetical currency adjusts for differences in the cost of living between countries
PPPs are based on detailed price data collected in “rounds” every few years

claims.statement: 世界銀行は国民経済計算で観測された成長率を用いて、各国の所得分布を基準年に「ラインアップ」する。

evidence.quote: the World Bank “lines up” each country’s distribution to a reference year using growth rates observed in national accounts data

claims.statement: 現在は世界人口のほぼ10%が極度の貧困にあるが、200年前にはほぼ80%が同じ状態にあった。

evidence.quote: The chart shows that almost 10% of the world's population lives in extreme poverty. It also tells us that two hundred years ago, the same was true for nearly 80% of the world’s population.

claims.statement: 1950年には世界の約半数、1990年でも3分の1超が極度の貧困にあったが、2019年には世界人口に占める割合が10%を下回った。

evidence.quote: In 1950, about half the world lived in extreme poverty; in 1990, it was still more than a third. By 2019, the share of the world population in extreme poverty had fallen below 10%.

claims.statement: この2世紀の間に世界人口は7倍に増加した。

evidence.quote: the world population has increased 7-fold in the last two centuries

claims.statement: 1990年以降、極度の貧困の人口は平均して1日あたり13万人ずつ減少してきた。

evidence.quote: on average, there were 130,000 people fewer in extreme poverty every day

claims.statement: 世界人口の多数は依然として貧困状態にあり、10人にほぼ1人が極度の貧困、3分の2が1日10ドル未満で暮らしている。

evidence.quote: The majority of the world population still lives in poverty: Almost every tenth person lives in extreme poverty, and two-thirds live on less than $10 per day.

claims.statement: 富裕国の基準である1日30ドル未満という貧困の定義を適用すると、世界の85%が貧困状態にあることになる。

evidence.quote: In rich countries, a person is considered poor when she or he lives on less than $30 per day; if we rely on this poverty definition, then we find that 85% of the world lives in poverty.

claims.statement: 過去数十年に見られた極度の貧困削減の進展は止まり、世界の最貧層が暮らす多くの国で所得が停滞している。

evidence.quote: The progress seen in reducing extreme poverty over the past decades has ended. Incomes are stagnating in many countries where the world’s poorest live.

claims.statement: このままでは2030年までに極度の貧困を根絶する目標は達成できない見通しである。

evidence.quote: we are very clearly on track to fail in eradicating extreme poverty by 2030

claims.statement: 自給農業に依存する人々を考慮するため、統計担当者は自家生産物の金銭的価値を推定し、所得または消費支出に加算している。

evidence.quote: the statisticians who produce these figures estimate the monetary value of their home production and add it to their income or consumption expenditure

claims.statement: PIPの調査データは富裕国では所得、貧しい国では消費支出を測る傾向があり、同じ国・同じ年でも所得を用いる方が貧困率は高くなる傾向がある。

evidence.quote: The survey data included within the World Bank PIP database tends to measure people’s income in richer countries and people’s consumption expenditure in poorer countries.
Poverty rates tend to be higher when income is used rather than consumption, for the same country and year.

claims.statement: 世界規模の所得調査は存在せず、研究者は利用可能な各国調査に依存している。

evidence.quote: There is no global survey of incomes. To understand how incomes across the world compare, researchers need to rely on available national surveys.

claims.statement: 調査のカバー率は過去にさかのぼるほど低く、サハラ以南アフリカでは特にまばらである。

evidence.quote: coverage is generally poorer the further back in time you look, and remains particularly patchy within Sub-Saharan Africa

claims.statement: 1国際ドルは、基準年において米国で1米ドルが持つのと同じ購買力を持つと定義される。

evidence.quote: One international dollar is defined as having the same purchasing power as one US dollar would in the United States in a given base year.

claims.statement: 絶対的貧困ラインは時間を通じて一定の生活水準を表す閾値であり、相対的貧困ラインは国内の平均所得の変化に応じて上下する。

evidence.quote: An absolute poverty line represents a fixed standard of living; a threshold that is held constant across time.
the value of relative poverty lines rises and falls as average incomes change within a given country

claims.statement: 英国の国内貧困ラインはIPLの約10倍にあたる1日約30ドルであり、この閾値を世界に適用すると世界人口の80%が貧困とカウントされる。

evidence.quote: national poverty is measured using a threshold ten times higher than the IPL, close to $30 per day
if we apply this threshold globally, the vast majority — 80% — of the world’s population would be counted as poor

claims.statement: 1820年には世界で読み書きができたのは10人に1人だったが、現在は非識字者が10人に1人へと逆転した。

evidence.quote: While only one in ten people in the world could read and write in 1820, today, the share has reversed, with only one in ten remaining illiterate.
In many countries, more than 95% have basic literacy skills.

claims.statement: サハラ以南アフリカの一部の国では、15歳以上の成人の3人に1人未満しか読み書きができない。

evidence.quote: In some countries in sub-Saharan Africa, fewer than 1-in-3 adults (aged over 15 years) are able to both read and write.

claims.statement: 文字によるコミュニケーションは紀元前3500年から3000年ごろに始まったが、何世紀もの間、識字は権力の行使と結びついた限定的な技術だった。

evidence.quote: the earliest forms of written communication date back to about 3,500-3,000 BCE, for centuries literacy remained a very restricted technology closely associated with the exercise of power

claims.statement: 初期工業化した国々で識字率が普遍化に近づいたのは19世紀から20世紀に入ってからである。

evidence.quote: It was only in the 19th and 20th centuries that rates of literacy approached universality in early-industrialized countries.
While the ambition of universal literacy in Europe was a fundamental reform born from the Enlightenment, it took centuries for it to happen.

claims.statement: 200年前に読み書きができたのは世界人口の約12%と推定される。

evidence.quote: the best estimate is that 12% of the world population was literate

claims.statement: 19世紀の間に世界の識字率は2倍以上に増加した。

evidence.quote: Over the course of the 19th century, global literacy more than doubled.

claims.statement: 現在、世界で読むことができるのは5人に4人以上である。

evidence.quote: More than 4 out of 5 people are now able to read.

claims.statement: 1870年には世界で4人に1人しか学校に通わず、読める人も5人に1人だった。

evidence.quote: in 1870, only one in four people in the world attended school, and this meant that only one in five were able to read

claims.statement: 今日では識字率と就学率の世界推定値はともに80%を超える。

evidence.quote: the global estimates of literacy and school attendance are above 80%

claims.statement: ハイチのような貧しい国では、21世紀の初めでも人口の半分が非識字のままだった。

evidence.quote: at the turn of the 21st century, half of the population in poor countries such as Haiti remains illiterate

claims.statement: 1600年から1800年にかけて、北西ヨーロッパで特に速い識字率の改善が起きた。

evidence.quote: Particularly fast improvements in literacy took place across Northwest Europe in the period 1600-1800.

claims.statement: ノーウィッチ教区の記録では、16世紀末に男性の61%が名前を書くことができなかった。

evidence.quote: the majority of men (61%) were unable to write their names in the late 16th century

claims.statement: 1840年のイングランドでは、男性の3分の2と女性の約半分が識字だった。

evidence.quote: By 1840, two-thirds of men and about half of women were literate in England.

claims.statement: 識字率の改善は産業革命に先行した。

evidence.quote: improvements in literacy preceded the Industrial Revolution

claims.statement: 米国では人種間の識字ギャップを解消することでほぼ普遍的な識字率が達成され、それは1980年ごろに実現した。

evidence.quote: in order to reach near-universal levels of literacy, the US had to close the race gap. This was eventually achieved around 1980.

claims.statement: 北アフリカと中東の多くの国では、高齢世代で識字なのは3分の1未満であるのに対し、若年世代では90%以上が識字である。

evidence.quote: only less than a third of the older generation is literate – while in contrast, more than 90% of the younger generation is literate

claims.statement: 若年層の高い識字率は、時間が経つにつれて全人口の識字率が上昇し続けることを示唆する。

evidence.quote: the high literacy rate among the youth indicates that as time passes, the literacy rate for the overall population will continue to increase

claims.statement: UNESCOの識字率推定は、本人申告・世帯主代理申告・能力検定・間接推計または外挿の4つに分類される。

evidence.quote: self-reported literacy declared directly by individuals, self-reported literacy declared by the head of the household, tested literacy from proficiency examinations, and indirect estimation or extrapolation

claims.statement: 最近の識字データは多くの場合、国勢調査や家計調査に含まれる「読み書きができますか」という1つの質問への自己報告に基づく。

evidence.quote: recent data on literacy is often based on a single question included in national population censuses, or household surveys presented to respondents above a certain age, where literacy skills are self-reported
Can you read and write?

Literacy surveys have the potential of being more accurate – when the sampling is done correctly – because they allow for more specific and detailed measurement than short and generic questions in population censuses.

claims.statement: 識字は持つか持たないかの二値ではなく、連続的な多次元の技能である。

evidence.quote: literacy is a multi-dimensional skill that exists on a continuum

claims.statement: 世帯の一人が全員分を代理回答する調査では、世帯主とみなされにくい女性や子供の推計にノイズが入りやすい。

evidence.quote: surveys ask only one individual to report literacy on behalf of the entire household
these groups are less often considered 'heads of household' in the surveys

claims.statement: 就学歴に基づく識字の定義は国によって異なり、ギリシャでは6年の初等教育修了、パラグアイでは2年の修了で識字とみなされる。

evidence.quote: in Greece, people are considered literate if they have finished six years of primary education, while in Paraguay, you qualify as literate if you have completed two years of primary school

claims.statement: 署名による歴史的推計は下限しか示さない。読める人は書ける人より多かったためである。

evidence.quote: this approach only gives a lower bound of the estimates because the number of people who could read was higher than the number who could write

claims.statement: BuringhとVan Zandenは一人あたりの書籍消費量から識字率を推計した。

evidence.quote: researchers Eltjo Buringh and Jan Luiten van Zanden deduce literacy rates from estimated per capita book consumption

claims.statement: 1800年代初頭には成人の5人に1人未満しか基礎教育を受けていなかった。

evidence.quote: In the early 1800s, fewer than 1 in 5 adults had some basic education.

claims.statement: 現在は正式教育を受けていない成人が5人に1人未満である。

evidence.quote: Less than 1 in 5 adults has not received any formal education.

claims.statement: 低所得国では、初等教育を終えても読めない子供が大多数である。

evidence.quote: in low-income countries, most children cannot read by the end of primary school

claims.statement: 2023年時点で、初等・中等教育のいずれにも通っていない子供は約2億4400万人いる。

evidence.quote: This number was around 244 million in 2023.

claims.statement: 就学率の男女差は世界全体ではほぼ解消した。

evidence.quote: Today, these gender gaps have largely disappeared.

claims.statement: UNESCOの識字率指標が捉えるのは「短い簡単な文を理解して読み書きできる」という基本的な技能だけである。

evidence.quote: only captures very basic literacy skills: being able to read and write a short, simple sentence with understanding

claims.statement: ワクチンは公衆衛生上最も強力な手段の一つである。

evidence.quote: Vaccines are one of the most powerful tools in public health.

claims.statement: ワクチンははしか・ポリオ・天然痘のような致死的疾患を防ぐことで数億人の命を救ってきた。

evidence.quote: They have saved hundreds of millions of lives by preventing deadly diseases like measles, polio, and smallpox.

claims.statement: 十分な人数が接種すると病原体は広がりにくくなり、新生児や免疫疾患のある人など接種できない人も保護される。

evidence.quote: when enough people are vaccinated, a pathogen is much less able to multiply within people and spread to others
This protects those who get the vaccine and those who can’t, like newborns, people with certain immune conditions, or those on certain medications that suppress the immune system

claims.statement: はしかのように容易に広がる疾患では、集団免疫と流行防止に典型的には90%を超える接種率が必要とされる。

evidence.quote: For diseases that spread easily, like measles, very high vaccination coverage — typically above 90% — is needed to reach herd immunity and prevent outbreaks.

claims.statement: ジフテリア・破傷風・百日咳を防ぐDTPワクチンは3回の接種が必要で、その接種率は各国の定期接種のベンチマークとして使われる。

evidence.quote: the DTP vaccine, which protects against diphtheria, tetanus, and pertussis. Because it requires three doses, DTP coverage is often used as a benchmark for how well countries deliver routine vaccinations.

claims.statement: 今日、世界の乳児の8割超、1億人超がDTPの全接種回数を毎年受けている。

evidence.quote: Today, over 80% of infants worldwide — over a hundred million babies — receive the full course annually

claims.statement: 接種率は欧州・アジア・北米で高く、アフリカと南米で低い傾向がある。

evidence.quote: vaccination rates tend to be higher in countries in Europe, Asia, and North America than in Africa and South America

claims.statement: ワクチンが子供に重要だと考える人が多い国でも接種率が低いことがあり、低い接種率はアクセス不足や供給途絶など態度以外の理由を示す。

evidence.quote: Many countries where more people agree that vaccines are important for children also have lower vaccination rates.
This points to other reasons for lower vaccination coverage rates, including lower access and supply disruptions

claims.statement: WHOは3か月分のワクチン備蓄を推奨するが、多くの国はそれを維持できていない。

evidence.quote: The WHO recommends a three-month buffer stock of vaccines, but many countries struggle to maintain this

claims.statement: 2022年には約90か国が少なくとも1種類のワクチン不足を報告した。

evidence.quote: around 90 countries reported shortages of at least one vaccine in 2022

claims.statement: 不足が最も多かったのは経口ポリオ・DTP・BCGの各ワクチンだった。

evidence.quote: The most common were oral polio, DTP, and BCG vaccines

claims.statement: 医療基盤の弱さと不安定なコールドチェーンが、ワクチンの適温維持を難しくしている。

evidence.quote: Weak healthcare infrastructure and unreliable cold storage systems make it difficult to keep vaccines at the right temperature.

claims.statement: 政治的不安定・紛争・資金不足・経済危機もワクチンの配送を妨げる。

evidence.quote: Political instability, conflicts, funding shortages, and economic crises can also disrupt vaccine deliveries.

claims.statement: ワクチン不足は接種を遅らせ、疾患流行のリスクを高める。

evidence.quote: These shortages delay vaccinations and increase the risk of disease outbreaks.

claims.statement: Gavi・WHOの予防接種拡大計画・各国の接種計画は、コスト削減・流通改善・医療従事者育成に寄与してきた。

evidence.quote: Initiatives like Gavi, the WHO’s Expanded Programme on Immunization, and national vaccination programs have helped lower costs, improve distribution, and train healthcare workers.

claims.statement: 高い接種率の維持と、まだ届いていない残り20%の子供への到達が残された課題である。

evidence.quote: maintaining high vaccination rates and reaching the last 20% of children

claims.statement: Shattockらの推計では、定期接種は過去50年間に世界で1億5400万人の死亡を防いだ。

evidence.quote: routine vaccinations prevented 154 million deaths worldwide in just the last fifty years

claims.statement: はしかワクチンだけで9400万人の命を救い、最もインパクトの大きいワクチンとなった。

evidence.quote: Measles vaccination alone has saved 94 million lives, making it the most impactful vaccine.

claims.statement: 天然痘はワクチン接種により1980年に世界で根絶された。

evidence.quote: smallpox, which was eradicated worldwide in 1980 through vaccination

claims.statement: 1955年のソーク不活化ポリオワクチンと1960年のセービン経口ポリオワクチンが伝染を止め、症例を激減させた。

evidence.quote: Jonas Salk’s inactivated polio vaccine, introduced in 1955, and Albert Sabin’s oral polio vaccine, introduced in 1960, stopped transmission and dramatically reduced cases.

claims.statement: ポリオは軽症・無症状でも静かに広がるため、高い接種率が不可欠である。

evidence.quote: polio can spread silently among those with mild or no symptoms, making high vaccination coverage essential

claims.statement: 半世紀前、欧州と北米以外で接種を受ける子供はほとんどおらず、DTP3ワクチンを受けた乳児は5%未満だった。

evidence.quote: 50 years ago, very few children were vaccinated outside of Europe and North America. For example, fewer than 5% of infants received the vaccine against diphtheria, pertussis, and tetanus (DTP3).

claims.statement: 1974年、世界保健総会は主要な疾患に対して世界のすべての子供への接種を目指す予防接種計画を発足させた。

evidence.quote: In 1974, the World Health Assembly – the WHO’s decision-making body – formed the Essential Programme on Immunization, which aimed to vaccinate all children in the world against the main diseases for which vaccines exist, such as measles, tetanus, tuberculosis, and smallpox.

claims.statement: 接種率は急上昇して世界の子供の6割超に広がったが、2000年までには停滞が明らかになり、最貧層の乳児が取り残されていた。

evidence.quote: vaccination rates increased steeply — expanding to over 60% of the world’s children
by 2000, it was clear that progress was stalling, and many of the world’s poorest infants were still being left behind

claims.statement: Gaviワクチンアライアンスは、ゲイツ財団・WHO・ユニセフ・世界銀行のパートナーシップとして、格差を埋め接種計画をすべての人に提供するために設立された。

evidence.quote: Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance — a partnership between the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, the WHO, Unicef, and the World Bank — was formed to close the gaps and ensure vaccination programs were available for all.

claims.statement: 現在、乳児の8割超がDTP3の全回接種を受け、はしか接種は2000年の20%未満から70%超へ、結核84%、ポリオとB型肝炎80%に達している。

evidence.quote: More than 80% of infants get all necessary doses of the DTP3 vaccine.
global vaccination against measles has increased from less than 20% in 2000 to over 70% today
84% of children are also vaccinated against tuberculosis, and 80% against polio and Hepatitis B.

claims.statement: 世界の乳児死亡率は1974年の約10%から3%未満へ3分の2以上低下し、この低下の40%はワクチンによるものと推定される。

evidence.quote: they’ve fallen by over two-thirds, from around 10% in 1974 to less than 3% today
vaccinations have reduced infant mortality by 40%

claims.statement: 子供の死亡の多くは、ワクチン・基本的な医薬品・経口補水・栄養補給・新生児医療で防ぐことができる。

evidence.quote: With vaccination, basic medication, rehydration treatment, nutrition supplementation, and neonatal healthcare, a large share of child deaths could be prevented.

claims.statement: FAOは食料不安を、正常な成長と発達、活動的で健康的な生活のために十分な量の安全かつ栄養のある食料への確実なアクセスを欠く状況と定義する。

evidence.quote: Food insecurity is defined by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) of the United Nations as the “situation when people lack secure access to sufficient amounts of safe and nutritious food for normal growth and development and an active and healthy life.”

claims.statement: 食料不安は栄養不良の主要な原因の一つである。

evidence.quote: Food insecurity is one of the major causes of poor nutrition.

claims.statement: 食料不安は、食料が物理的に存在しない場合、購入可能でも高すぎる場合、世帯内分配が不平等な場合に生じうる。

evidence.quote: Food insecurity can be caused by several factors: food might be physically unavailable in a particular country or region; it can be unaffordable even if it is available to buy; or there might be an unequal distribution of food between household members.

claims.statement: 食料不安はFAOの食料不安経験尺度（FIES）で測られ、世帯レベルのアンケートで中程度または深刻なレベルを経験した人の割合を算出する。

evidence.quote: Food insecurity is measured by the FAO using its Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES) global reference scale.

The FIES measures the share of the population that has experienced food insecurity at moderate or severe levels during the period of measurement. Data is collected at the household level using a food security questionnaire.

claims.statement: 食料不安は量だけでなく質の問題でもあり、エネルギー必要量を満たしても少数の基礎食品に頼る多様性のない食事は食料不安に含まれる。

evidence.quote: Food insecurity can be based on having enough food (the quantity) or having inadequate quality and diversity of food. Someone might get enough food to meet their energy requirements, but they might rely on only a few basic foods (such as cereals) and have a diet with very little diversity.

claims.statement: FIESは8つの質問に基づき、十分な食料への心配や食事を抜いた経験などを尋ねる。

evidence.quote: It’s based on eight questions (the full list is given at the end of this article), such as:
During the last 12 months, was there a time when you (or any other adult in the household) were worried you would not have enough food to eat because of a lack of money or other resources?
Was there a time when you (or any other adult in the household) had to skip a meal because there was not enough money or other resources to get food?

claims.statement: 8つの質問は深刻さの順に並び、心配から食事量の削減を経て、丸一日以上何も食べない段階まで進む。

evidence.quote: These eight questions increase in severity: the first question is about worrying that you might not have enough food to eat at some point over the year. This evolves to actually eating less than is sufficient, then finally to going a whole day or more without any food.
went without eating for a whole day because of a lack of money or other resources

claims.statement: 中程度の食料不安は健康的で栄養のある食事を定期的に食べられないことと結びつき、食事の質の低下と微量栄養素欠乏リスクの高さを示す。

evidence.quote: Moderate food insecurity is generally associated with the inability to regularly eat healthy, nutritious diets. It’s an important indicator of poor dietary quality and a high risk of micronutrient deficiencies.

claims.statement: 深刻な食料不安はエネルギー量の不足に強く結びつき、栄養不足すなわち飢餓と強く関連する。

evidence.quote: Severe food insecurity is more strongly related to insufficient quantity of food (energy) and therefore strongly related to undernourishment or hunger.

claims.statement: 深刻な食料不安の割合は原理的には栄養不足率と近いはずだが、前者は定性的な世帯調査、後者は実際の食料供給量に基づく定量的推計という違いがある。

evidence.quote: In principle, the share of people that are severely food insecure should be similar to the share of the people that are defined as undernourished.

Food insecurity is based on household survey responses, which are more qualitative measure. Undernourishment is estimated based on actual food availability across the population; its a more quantitative measure.

claims.statement: 両指標は強い相関を示すが完全一致ではなく、人々の主観的経験が実際の供給量と異なりうるためである。

evidence.quote: We see that these metrics are very strongly correlated, although not perfectly.
Peoples’ subjective experience of food availability might vary from their actual availability.

claims.statement: 栄養不足は年間平均の供給で測るため、短期間だけ深刻な食料不安を経験する人がいると調査ベースの推計は高めに出る。

evidence.quote: Undernourishment measurements are based on average calorie availability across the year. People might suffer from severe food insecurity on very short time scales i.e. they might have experienced a week of very little food, but have enough for the rest of the year.

claims.statement: 栄養不足率は人口の1日あたり食料摂取量が、正常で活動的かつ健康的な生活に必要な食事エネルギーを平均的に下回る人の割合を測る。

evidence.quote: The prevalence of undernourishment in any given country or region measures the share of the population that has a daily food intake that is insufficient to provide, on average, the amount of dietary energy required to maintain a normal, active and healthy life.

claims.statement: 必要カロリーは身長・体重・性・年齢・活動量で大きく異なり、摂取量も幅広いため、栄養不足は平均だけからは計算できない。

evidence.quote: The amount of calories that people need can be very different: factors such as someone’s height, weight, sex, age, and activity levels will mean that some people need more calories than others.
This means we cannot simply calculate undernourishment from an average of calorie consumption and requirements.

claims.statement: FAOは平均カロリー供給量・エネルギー摂取の変動係数・人口情報に基づく必要量分布の3要素をパラメトリック確率密度関数で合成して栄養不足率を推計し、個人は特定しない。

evidence.quote: They estimate the average availability of calories (energy) across the population.
They measure the levels of inequalities in food consumption within a population. This is called the Coefficient of Variation (CV) of energy intake.

they then calculate undernourishment using a ‘parametric probability density function’. This indicates the cumulative probability across a population that someone has a daily energy intake that is lower than the minimum requirements.
This undernourishment measure, therefore, does not tell us anything about what specific individuals are undernourished.

claims.statement: 現在も世界人口のほぼ10人に1人が十分な食料を得られていない。

evidence.quote: nearly one-in-ten people still do not get enough food to eat

claims.statement: 飢餓率はサハラ以南アフリカで最も高く、南アジアは南北アメリカや東アジアより高く、北米と欧州は2.5%未満として表示される。

evidence.quote: rates of hunger are highest in Sub-Saharan Africa. South Asia has much higher rates than the Americas and East Asia. Rates in North America and Europe are below 2.5%. However, the FAO shows this as “2.5%” rather than the specific point estimate.

claims.statement: 栄養不足率はカロリー摂取の充足度だけで決まり、食事の質や多様性を考慮しない。

evidence.quote: Undernourishment is solely determined by the sufficiency of energy (calorie) intake. It does not consider the quality or diversity of someone’s diet.

claims.statement: FAOは1970年に「発展途上国」の3人に1人が飢餓状態にあったと推計し、その率は2015年に12%まで急落した。

evidence.quote: The UN FAO estimated that one-in-three people in ‘developing countries’ suffered from hunger in 1970. Rates then plummeted, reaching 12% in 2015.

claims.statement: FAOは栄養不足の推計方法を変更しており、1970年代からの長期系列は更新されなくなった。

evidence.quote: the FAO has adapted its methodology for estimating undernourishment and no longer updates this long-term series from the 1970s

claims.statement: 直近10年間、ほとんどの地域で飢餓の減少が鈍化した。

evidence.quote: declines have slowed across most regions in the last decade

claims.statement: 国連は持続可能な開発目標で2030年までに飢餓を終わらせる目標を掲げたが、達成にはほど遠い。

evidence.quote: The UN has set a global target as part of the Sustainable Development Goals to “end hunger by 2030“. While the world has progressed in past decades, we are far from reaching this target.

claims.statement: 母子の栄養不足は、死亡その他の健康被害の主要な危険因子である。

evidence.quote: Undernourishment in mothers and children is a leading risk factor for death and other poor health outcomes.

claims.statement: 世界の多くの子供が依然として栄養不良で、一部の国では3分の1から半数の子供が発育阻害の状態にある。

evidence.quote: Many children across the world are still malnourished.
In some countries, over one-third and up to one-half of children are stunted

claims.statement: スタンティングは身長が同年齢のWHO健全成長曲線の中央値より2標準偏差以上低い状態として測られる。

evidence.quote: ‘Stunting’ is measured based on a child’s height relative to age.
If a child’s height is more than two standard deviations below the median height on this curve, they are defined as ‘stunted’.

claims.statement: 飢餓、正式には栄養不足は、活動的で健康的な生活を維持するのに必要なエネルギーを下回る食事をしている状態と定義される。

evidence.quote: Hunger – or, more formally, undernourishment – is defined as eating less than the energy required to maintain an active and healthy life.

claims.statement: 栄養不足はFAOの主要指標で飢餓とほぼ同義に使われるが、微量栄養素欠乏を含む広い意味の栄養不良の一構成要素にすぎない。

evidence.quote: ‘Undernourishment’ is the main indicator used by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations to measure the extent of food supplies and nutrition. It is often used interchangeably with the term ‘hunger’.
That means it is only one component of malnutrition: a broader term that also captures other types of nutrient deficiencies, such as micronutrients.

claims.statement: FAOの食料供給・消費データは1961年までさかのぼり、年次で更新される。

evidence.quote: comprehensive data on food supply and consumption is published by the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). This data is annually available and is updated by the FAO, extending back to 1961.

claims.statement: 1961年以降、1人あたりカロリー供給量は一貫して増加し、アジアとアフリカでの伸びが世界の供給格差を縮めた。

evidence.quote: Over the decades since 1961, there has been a consistent global uptrend in the per capita calorie supply

There has been a substantial increase in caloric supply in Asia and Africa in recent decades. The steeper rise across poorer regions of the world meant that over the last few decades, global trends in caloric supply have been converging.

claims.statement: 食料供給統計は消費段階での廃棄を含まず、実際の摂取量ではなく小売段階で入手可能な量を表す。

evidence.quote: supply figures do not include consumption-level waste (i.e. food that is wasted at retail, restaurant, and household levels), and therefore represent food available for consumption at the retail level, rather than actual food intake.

claims.statement: WHOは2017年に世界で約30万人の女性が妊娠関連で死亡したと推計し、1日平均約800人にあたる。

evidence.quote: The World Health Organization (WHO) estimates that around 300,000 women globally died from pregnancy-related deaths in 2017, which is around 800 each day on average.

claims.statement: ICD-11では、妊産婦死亡は妊娠中または妊娠終了後42日以内に妊娠関連の原因で死亡した女性の死で、偶発的・付随的な死因は除かれる。

evidence.quote: According to the ICD-11, maternal deaths are defined as the deaths of women while pregnant or within 42 days of termination of pregnancy, from pregnancy-related causes, but excluding accidental or incidental causes of death.

claims.statement: WHO死亡データベースとIHME GBDの推計では、妊娠終了後1年以内の死亡も含まれる。

evidence.quote: In the WHO Mortality Database and IHME GBD (estimates up to 2019), maternal deaths up to 1 year of termination of pregnancy are also included.

claims.statement: 妊産婦死亡率は、その年の妊娠関連死亡数を生殖年齢（通常15〜49歳）の女性数で割ったものである。

evidence.quote: Maternal Mortality Rate — which refers to the number of pregnancy-related deaths in a year divided by the number of women of reproductive age (normally 15 to 49 years old) alive that year

claims.statement: 妊産婦死亡比は、妊娠関連死亡数を同期間の出生数と比較する比率である。

evidence.quote: Maternal Mortality Ratio — which is a ratio comparing the number of pregnancy-related deaths to the number of births in the same period

claims.statement: 妊娠関連死亡のほとんどはサハラ以南アフリカで発生し、かなりの部分が南アジアで発生した。

evidence.quote: Most occurred in Sub-Saharan Africa, and a sizeable share occurred in South Asia.

claims.statement: 死亡がアフリカ・アジアに集中するのは一部には出生数が多いためだが、より重要なのは低所得国のはるかに高い死亡率である。

evidence.quote: This is partly because many more babies are born in Asia and Africa than in other regions.
But a more important factor is the much higher maternal mortality rates found in lower-income countries

claims.statement: 2017年の妊産婦死亡比は高所得国で出生10万件あたり約11、低所得国では約450で約40倍高かった。

evidence.quote: In high-income countries, the maternal mortality ratio was around 11 per 100,000 live births in 2017. But in low-income countries, it was around 450 per 100,000 — around 40 times higher.

claims.statement: 妊産婦死亡率は特にサハラ以南アフリカ、南米、南・東南アジアで高い傾向がある。

evidence.quote: Maternal mortality tends to be especially high in sub-Saharan Africa, South America, and South and South-East Asia.

claims.statement: 女性の生涯リスクは妊娠1回あたりのリスクと妊娠回数の両方に依存し、貧しい地域で出生数も多いため格差が増幅される。

evidence.quote: the chances that a woman dies from maternal causes are not only dependent on the risk per pregnancy — which we looked at above — but also the number of pregnancies she has.
Maternal mortality is higher in poorer regions, and the overall risks tend to be higher where women have more children. These amplify the differences in risk between high and low-income countries.

claims.statement: 熟練した医療スタッフ立ち会いの出産は多くの国でほぼ100%だが、医療アクセスがはるかに低い国も残る。

evidence.quote: For most countries this is close to 100%. But there are still some countries where healthcare access is much lower.

claims.statement: データには妊産婦死亡率が低くほぼすべての出産が熟練者立ち会いの国の集まりと、立ち会い率の低い国が現れる。

evidence.quote: this shows countries where the maternal mortality rate is low, and almost all births are attended by skilled personnel
we also see countries with much lower staff coverage

claims.statement: かつて産褥性敗血症は妊娠中の最も一般的な死因で、子宮の感染が出産直後の新しい母親を死に至らしめた。

evidence.quote: sepsis was the most common cause of death in pregnancy. The infection of the uterus killed new mothers shortly after childbirth.

claims.statement: ウィーン産科病院の第一棟では10人に1人の母親が産褥性敗血症で死亡し、第二棟では25人に1人だった。

evidence.quote: Doctors and medical students were taught in the first wing, while midwives were taught in the second. In the first wing, every tenth
mother died of puerperal sepsis, while in the second, "only” one in 25 died.

claims.statement: 入院は妊娠の複雑さではなく交互の日割りというほぼ無作為な割り当てで決まり、自然実験の条件を作っていた。

evidence.quote: women were admitted to the clinics not based on how complicated their pregnancy was, but simply on alternate days — in other words, by an almost random allocation
Unintentionally, the hospital had created the conditions suitable for a natural experiment

claims.statement: 第一棟の医学生は分娩補助と剖検を手洗いせずに交互に行い、第二棟の助産師学生は剖検を行わなかった。

evidence.quote: medical students alternated between helping women to give birth and attending post-mortem examinations of women who had died of puerperal sepsis
they did not wash their hands
the pupil midwives in the second clinic did not perform postmortem examinations

claims.statement: ゼンメルヴァイスは疾病が伝染性で医師が媒介していると結論づけ、病原体を破壊する化学薬品で学生に手指消毒を命じた。

evidence.quote: many years before germ theory had been developed, Semmelweis concluded that the disease was contagious and that it was the doctors who were transmitting it
Semmelweis also found that a chemical would destroy the agent that led to the disease, and therefore insisted that his students disinfect their hands with it before attending the pregnancy wards

claims.statement: 産褥性敗血症が伝染性だという発見は当時の医学的通念に合わず、医学界を納得させるまで長い時間を要した。

evidence.quote: Semmelweis's insistence on his discovery that puerperal sepsis was contagious did not fit into the accepted medical understanding of the time, and this meant an agonizingly slow process of convincing the medical establishment

claims.statement: 防腐法は19世紀後半に産科実践へ広く導入され、20世紀前半の抗生物質と輸血と相まって分娩死リスクを急激に低下させた。

evidence.quote: Only in the second half of the 19th century was antisepsis widely introduced into routine obstetric practice. But this change — coupled with the discovery of antibiotics and the development of blood transfusion in the first half of the 20th century — sharply drove down the risk of dying in childbirth.

claims.statement: 手指消毒によって1848年までに二つの棟の妊産婦死亡率はほぼ同水準になった。

evidence.quote: This led to dramatic results. By 1848, the maternal mortality rates of the two clinics in the Vienna Maternity Hospital were comparable.

claims.statement: 死亡率低下は原因理解の進展と予防実践の採用によるもので、20世紀には抗生物質が産褥熱を治療可能にした。

evidence.quote: The dramatic decline in maternal mortality is due to improvements in understanding the causes of maternal mortality and the adoption of practices to prevent it.
in the 20th century, the availability of antibiotics made it possible to treat cases of puerperal fever, and the death of a mother from this condition is today much less common.

claims.statement: フィンランドの低下は19世紀半ばに始まり今日の水準まで1世紀以上かかったが、インドやアフガニスタンはずっと後により短い期間で大幅な低下を達成した。

evidence.quote: The decline of maternal mortality in Finland, for example, began in the middle of the 19th century and didn’t reach today’s low level more than a century later. In contrast, India and Afghanistan, for example, have achieved large declines much later, but in a shorter amount of time.

claims.statement: 妊産婦死亡のほぼすべては、適切な妊産婦ケア・安全な分娩・良好な栄養・衛生と環境衛生の改善で予防可能である。

evidence.quote: almost all of the world’s pregnancy-related deaths are preventable with improvements in adequate maternal care, safe deliveries, good nutrition and hygiene and sanitation.

claims.statement: 1800年のスウェーデンとフィンランドでは出生10万件あたり約900人の母親が死亡し、ほぼ100人に1人にあたった。

evidence.quote: In Sweden and Finland in 1800, for example, around 900 mothers died for every 100,000 live births

claims.statement: 1800年水準の死亡率が続いていれば、今日の出生数では年間約126万人の母親が死亡する計算になる。

evidence.quote: if we still had the living standards of 1800, around 1.26 million women would die from pregnancy every year

claims.statement: 今日最も低い地域であるEUでは出生10万件あたり8人で、全世界がこの水準なら年間死亡は約1万1000人になる。

evidence.quote: Today the world region with the lowest maternal mortality is the European Union, where 8 women die per 100,000 live births.
if all countries had this level of maternal mortality, 11,000 would die

claims.statement: 全地域がEU水準ならほぼ30万人の死亡減、95%以上の削減となる。

evidence.quote: Almost 300,000 fewer deaths; a reduction of over 95%.

claims.statement: 世界の妊産婦死亡の95%は低・中低所得国で発生している。

evidence.quote: 95% occur in low and lower-middle-income countries

claims.statement: EUより低い国もあり、フィンランドは出生10万件あたり3、スウェーデンは4である。

evidence.quote: Finland has a rate of 3 per 100,000 live births, and Sweden has a rate of 4.

claims.statement: 毎日約830人が予防可能な妊娠・出産関連の原因で死亡しており、これはWHOのメッセージでもある。

evidence.quote: “Every day, approximately 830 women die from preventable causes related to pregnancy and childbirth.
